top_deficiency_types.title: Provide appropriate pressure ulcer care and prevent new ulcers from developing.

top_deficiency_types.title: Ensure services provided by the nursing facility meet professional standards of quality.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide pharmaceutical services to meet the needs of each resident and employ or obtain the services of a licensed pharmacist.
Add doors in an exit area that do not require the use of a key from the exit side unless in case of special locking arrangements.
Ensure that special areas are constructed so that walls can resist fire for one hour or have an approved fire extinguishing system.
Install corridor and hallway doors that block smoke.
Have restrictions on the use of highly flammable decorations.
Provide appropriate care for residents who are continent or incontinent of bowel/bladder, appropriate catheter care,  and appropriate care  to prevent urinary tract infections.
